title: Affine derived adjunction unit and counit are isomorphisms
statement: For any commutative ring A and derived-category universe choices, let F : D(A) → D_QCoh(Spec A) and G : D_QCoh(Spec A) → D(A) be functors with an adjunction adj : F ⊣ G. Suppose Q followed by F and inclusion is naturally isomorphic to termwise tilde followed by Q, and G is naturally isomorphic to derived global sections with scalars transported by ΓSpecIso. Then every component of the unit and counit of adj is an isomorphism.

proof.text: For every K and n, use the derived counit cohomology factorization. H^n(K) is quasi-coherent, so its ordinary tilde-global-sections counit is invertible. The factorization therefore makes H^n(inclusion(adj.counit_K)) invertible. DerivedCategory.isIso_iff detects invertibility, and the full-subcategory inclusion reflects it.

The natural tilde homology comparison transports invertibility of F.map f to invertibility of tilde(H^n(f)) for every n. Full faithfulness of ordinary tilde reflects these isomorphisms; DerivedCategory.isIso_iff then shows f invertible. Thus F reflects isomorphisms.

The left triangle identity says F(unit_M) followed by counit_(F M) is the identity. Since the counit is invertible, isIso_of_comp_hom_eq_id makes F(unit_M) invertible. Reflect through F using the preceding step. Pair this with the already proved counit assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem affineQCohDerivedAdjunction_unit_counit (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (G : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (adj : F ⊣ G)
    (hF : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⋙
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ≅
        @Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
            SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q))
    (hG : Nonempty (G ≅ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ⋙
        (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv.hom).rightDerivedFunctor)) :
    (∀ M, IsIso (adj.unit.app M)) ∧ (∀ K, IsIso (adj.counit.app K))
